put.summary: Check a Hostinger API token with Hostinger, then save it
put.description: Replaces any saved token, but only if Hostinger accepts the new one. On any error nothing is saved and an earlier token stays as it was.

200.description: Hostinger accepted the token; it is saved (state CONNECTED)

400.description: The token is missing, blank or too long

422.description: Hostinger rejected the token (HTTP 401/403); not saved

429.description: Hostinger's rate limit is reached; not saved, try again later

502.description: Hostinger could not be reached or answered with an error; not saved

delete.summary: Remove the Hostinger token from Dockline
delete.description: Afterwards HOSTINGER is NOT_CONNECTED. Does nothing when no token is saved.

get.summary: Recent warnings and errors, newest first (at most 500)

delete.summary: Clears the list (log files are kept)

get.summary: The user's Hostinger websites (from Hostinger, or the copy saved in the last 60 s)
get.description: Follows all pages of Hostinger's website list. Hostinger's answers are kept in memory for 60 seconds and reused, so `fetchedAt` may be up to a minute old; `refresh=true` asks Hostinger again. Dockline sends Hostinger at most 50 requests per minute across all features; a request over that waits its turn (up to a minute, then HOSTINGER_UNAVAILABLE). Errors are problem responses with a stable `code` property: HOSTINGER_NOT_CONNECTED (409), HOSTINGER_TOKEN_REJECTED (409, replace the token), HOSTINGER_RATE_LIMITED (429, Retry-After header when Hostinger sends one) and HOSTINGER_UNAVAILABLE (502). Hostinger failures are written to the Log section and update HOSTINGER in GET /api/status at once.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: True skips the copy saved in the last 60 seconds and asks Hostinger again (still counts towards the 50 requests per minute); the new answer is saved

409.description: code HOSTINGER_NOT_CONNECTED: no Hostinger token saved; code HOSTINGER_TOKEN_REJECTED: Hostinger rejected the saved token (revoked or expired), replace it

429.description: code HOSTINGER_RATE_LIMITED: Hostinger's rate limit is reached

502.description: code HOSTINGER_UNAVAILABLE: Hostinger could not be reached, timed out, failed or answered unexpectedly

get.summary: The user's repositories, fetched from GitHub now
get.description: Every call asks GitHub (no cache) and follows all pages. Errors are problem responses with a stable `code` property: GITHUB_NOT_CONNECTED (409), GITHUB_TOKEN_REJECTED (409, reconnect), GITHUB_RATE_LIMITED (429, Retry-After header when known) and GITHUB_UNAVAILABLE (502). GitHub failures are written to the Log section and update GITHUB in GET /api/status at once.

200.description: All repositories, most recently pushed first

409.description: code GITHUB_NOT_CONNECTED: no GitHub token saved; code GITHUB_TOKEN_REJECTED: GitHub rejected the saved token (revoked or expired), reconnect

429.description: code GITHUB_RATE_LIMITED: GitHub's rate limit is reached

502.description: code GITHUB_UNAVAILABLE: GitHub could not be reached, timed out, failed or answered unexpectedly

HostingerTokenRequest.description: A Hostinger API token created in hPanel

token.description: The API token; surrounding whitespace is ignored

ConnectionState.description: CONNECTED: a token is stored and works (green). LIMITED: works, but not fully, e.g. missing permissions or rate-limited (yellow). ERROR: a token is stored but cannot be used, e.g. revoked, or the token store is unavailable (red). NOT_CONNECTED: no token is stored (red).

message.description: Why the state is what it is (always for LIMITED and ERROR; may be set otherwise, e.g. 'Connected as octocat'); never contains a token

GithubDeviceCode.description: Show userCode and open verificationUri; then poll every intervalSeconds

userCode.description: Short code the user types on GitHub's page

verificationUri.description: Page to open in the browser

intervalSeconds.description: Poll POST /api/github/connect/poll no more often than this

GithubConnectProgress.description: Result of checking whether the user has approved yet

intervalSeconds.description: For PENDING: seconds to wait before polling again (grows by 5 when GitHub asks Dockline to slow down)

message.description: For DENIED, EXPIRED and ERROR: what happened, for the user

GithubConnectState.description: NOT_STARTED: no connection attempt since the app started (or since disconnect). PENDING: waiting for the user to approve on GitHub; poll again after intervalSeconds. CONNECTED: approved; the token is saved. DENIED: the user clicked Cancel on GitHub; start again to retry. EXPIRED: the code expired before it was approved; start again to retry. ERROR: something else went wrong, see message; start again to retry.

LogEntry.description: A warning or error reported by the backend. Tokens are always masked.

id.description: Unique within one backend run; newer entries have higher ids

action.description: What the backend was doing, e.g. "GET /user"

statusCode.description: HTTP status code involved, if any

request.description: The request that failed (method, URL, relevant headers/body)

HostingerSite.description: One website in the user's Hostinger hosting (Hostinger's website list)

domain.description: The website's domain; null for a website with no domain attached

username.description: The hosting account's username (CloudLinux websites); null for other platforms

orderId.description: The hosting order (plan) the website belongs to

websiteType.description: What Hostinger detected on the site: wordpress, builder, horizons, nodejs or other

rootDirectory.description: Root directory on the server (CloudLinux websites); null for other platforms

enabled.description: False when Hostinger has suspended the website

createdAt.description: When the website was created (ISO-8601, UTC)

HostingerSites.description: The user's Hostinger websites, as Hostinger listed them at fetchedAt

sites.description: Sorted by domain (A-Z); websites without a domain last

fetchedAt.description: When Dockline fetched this from Hostinger (ISO-8601, UTC); up to 60 s old when the saved copy was reused

truncated.description: True when the list stopped at 10 pages of 100 and more websites exist

GithubRepositories.description: The user's repositories, fetched from GitHub just now

repositories.description: Most recently pushed first; never-pushed ones last

fetchedAt.description: When Dockline fetched this from GitHub (ISO-8601, UTC)

truncated.description: True when the list stopped at 50 pages of 100 and more repositories exist

GithubRepository.description: One repository the user owns, collaborates on or sees through an organization

lastPushAt.description: Last push (ISO-8601, UTC); null for a repository nobody has pushed to

GithubVisibility.description: PRIVATE: only people with access see it. PUBLIC: anyone can.
